resourceName: Zhengzhou Lvyuan Food Waste Treatment Project
description:
Zhengzhou Lvyuan Food Waste Treatment Project (hereinafter referred to as the project) is located at the Houzhai Food Waste Treatment Plant, Erqi District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China. The project is owned and implemented by Zhengzhou Lvyuan Food Waste Treatment Co., Ltd. 
The purpose of the project is to treat MSW with anaerobic digesters and utilize recovered biogas for electricity generation. The project activity includes MSW collection, MSW pre-treatment system, anaerobic digestion tank, biogas purification, electricity generation system, heat generation system and waste heat recovery. However, in terms of the heat generation system and the waste heat recovery, the waste heat will be recovered to be the source of heat supply for the operation. To be conservative, emission reductions will not be claimed for heat generation system and for the waste heat recovery. 
The fresh waste of the project is mainly kitchen and catering waste of the Zhengzhou City and the design processing capacity of the project for the fresh waste is 300 tonnes per day. The biogas from anaerobic digestion will be used for electricity generation with internal combustion generators. The total installed capacity will be 2.252 MW included 2 generators with each 1.126 MW. 
The liquid digestate and solid digestate will be produced in anaerobic digester. The solid digestate will be transported directly to a nearby landfill for landfill and will not be stored under anaerobic conditions. And the wastewater will be discharged through the water treatment system up to standard. 
The project is to utilize the biogas produced by anaerobic digestion for power generation. The electricity generated by the project is supplied to Central China Power Grid (CCPG) which is dominated by coal-fired power stations. Before the implementation of the project activity, the fresh waste would be treated in a landfill site with a partial capture of the landfill gas (LFG) and flaring of the captured LFG.
